$description: Enterprise Design System Master Design Tokens in W3C DTCG Format

primary.$description: Nexus Design System Deep Navy for primary interactive actions

secondary.$description: Nexus Accent Blue for secondary actions and interactive highlights

danger.$description: Destructive actions, error badges, and critical validation alerts

success.$description: Positive operational status, successful confirmations, healthy badges

warning.$description: Attention-needed states, threshold breaches, and cautionary warnings

surface.$description: Secondary background layer for sidebars, containers, and table headers

surface_raised.$description: Raised card or modal surface against canvas

text_primary.$description: Primary typography with maximum WCAG contrast (> 7:1)

text_secondary.$description: Secondary supporting text, metadata, and column headers

text_inverse.$description: Text rendered over dark or primary saturated backgrounds

border_subtle.$description: Subtle container dividers and table row borders

focus.$description: Focus ring indicator for keyboard navigation (WCAG 2.4.7)

spacing.$description: Harmonic spatial grid scale based on 8px base grid

2xs.$description: 2px - Micro-padding between icon and adjacent label

xs.$description: 4px - Compact badge padding and tight item gaps

sm.$description: 8px - Standard gap between form fields and card elements

md.$description: 16px - Base unit padding for table cells and containers

xl.$description: 32px - Page layout gutters and header spacing

2xl.$description: 48px - Major section separation in high-density views

typography.$description: System typography scale adhering to enterprise readability

font_family_sans.$description: Primary corporate UI sans-serif font family

font_family_mono.$description: Monospace font for code, hashes, timestamps, and numeric identifiers

font_size_xs.$description: 12px - Timestamps, badge labels, and fine print

font_size_sm.$description: 14px - Table data rows, helper text, and secondary navigation

font_size_base.$description: 16px - Default body copy and input field values

radius.$description: Corner curvature tokens (Anti-slop rule: sharp, precise enterprise geometry)

none.$description: Sharp corners for tables and enterprise tabs

sm.$description: Subtle precision radius for tags, tooltips, and badges

md.$description: Standard border radius for buttons, inputs, and cards

lg.$description: Radius for modals, drawers, and floating panels

full.$description: Fully rounded pill shape for status badges and circular avatars

elevation.$description: Layered surface depth tokens replacing harsh 1px borders

subtle.$description: Subtle surface depth for cards and default containers

raised.$description: Interactive cards, dropdown menus, and hovered states

floating.$description: Modals, slide-over sheets, and high-elevation dialogs
